reply: Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the confusion around invoice INV-88410. Seat removals take effect at your next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle, so the invoice you received may still reflect the previous seat count — this is described in our article "Seat count changes and billing impact" (kb-0011). Because you're disputing a charge, I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist. To help them review it, please confirm the invoice id (INV-88410), the specific line you're disputing, and the amount you expected (~$1,200). Disputes of this kind are held from collections while under review.
